name: The incumbent: equal-weight ten-ETF basket — construction, out-of-sample 2007-2014, lucky-basket test, stress

construction.rebalance_A: daily to equal weight (the series every 2026-09-02 overlay was measured against)
construction.rebalance_B: monthly, first session, 3.0 bp on turnover (the retail-implementable version) — reported alongside
construction.data: yfinance auto-adjusted daily closes (research/incumbent/data.py), cached; close-to-close log returns
construction.why_yfinance: daily_universe (2014+) and Alpaca (2016+) cannot reach the out-of-sample window

windows.in_sample_note: the window the basket was 'found' on (HYP-109 incumbent)
windows.oos_note: all 30 pool ETFs exist from 2007-05 (UNG/HYG last); includes GFC

c1_oos_existence.stat: annualised Sharpe of rebalance_A on out_of_sample
c1_oos_existence.pass: stationary block bootstrap (L=20, 10000 draws, seed 42) 95% CI excludes 0 from above

c2_not_lucky.stat: percentile rank of the basket's Sharpe among 10,000 random equal-weight baskets of 10 drawn without replacement from the 30-ETF pool (seed 42), computed separately in_sample and out_of_sample

c3_stress.stat: max drawdown of rebalance_A vs SPY and vs 60/40 SPY/TLT (daily rebalanced) in each stress window
c3_stress.pass: basket maxDD less severe than SPY in all three windows

descriptive: calendar-year returns 2007-2026, basket vs SPY vs 60/40

verdict_ladder.VALIDATED_CORE: c1 pass AND not_lucky AND c3 pass
verdict_ladder.ORDINARY: c1 pass AND not_lucky AND c3 fails — a real but unremarkable diversified basket

operator.prior: not stated (forwarded a proposal: 'validated core or dodged a fitted basket')

claude.prior: ORDINARY — OOS Sharpe ~0.3-0.5 (GFC crushes EEM/XLF/XLE, TLT/GLD offset), percentile ~50-70; maxDD in GFC will NOT beat 60/40 and may not beat SPY by much

abort.no_scan: no search across weights, pools, windows or rebalance rules
